title: Transfer a movable ticket
prompt: Ticket is move-only. Moving one Ticket transfers its positive identifier to the destination and sets the source identifier to zero. Both moving construction and moving assignment must work, including self-move. Copying stays disabled.
signature: class Ticket: move constructor noexcept, move assignment noexcept, int id() const

tests.label: Move construction
tests.hint: Clear the source as the destination takes its id.

tests.label: Self move
tests.hint: Check whether source and destination are the same object.

tests.label: Zero is moved-from state
tests.hint: An already moved-from Ticket holds zero.

hints: std::exchange(other.id_,0) returns the old id and replaces it with zero.
For move assignment, handle the same object on both sides.
explanation: std::move marks a source as eligible to move; the move member performs the transfer. noexcept states that the transfer itself does not throw.
